title: Behavior of preoculomotor burst neurons during eye-head coordination.
abstract: Single-unit recordings from the pontine reticular formation in four monkeys have shown the presence of two classes of short-lead burst neurons firing during coordinated eye-head movements. The activity of one class showed a correlation with the size of saccadic movements performed during head movements; the other showed a correlation between firing pattern and the combined eye-head movement. Anatomical reconstructions of the recording sites point to an intermingling of the two cell types.
